scenario.title: No project, a new project or an established project
situations: Finish machine setup without a project
Start an empty project or a folder without Git
Adopt a mature app or reconnect an existing Yoke project
scenario.current: Research trace; requirements and source paths need live proof.
scenario.review: Older research may describe heavier onboarding. Apply minimum activation and optional-adoption boundaries first.
questions: Can already-onboarded projects enter current work without restarting Onboard?
Does the handoff reach one useful outcome, including mature-project and no-project branches?

lessons.title: Prepare the right folder and project identity
lessons.need: Distinguish no folder, missing Git, a non-Git folder, an unregistered repository and an already registered project. Preserve existing content and identity.
lessons.surface: Setup preparation, existing-project detection and project install
lessons.gap: Direct project install and setup preparation have different boundaries. The guide’s create/import recipes also need the previously audited required-config correction.

lessons.title: Hand off to an agent in the actual project
lessons.need: TUI completion has no agent yet. Open a session in the chosen checkout. A projectless agent selects/adds the project and carries intent into a project session.
lessons.surface: Machine/project finish → global guide or project Onboard
lessons.gap: Accepted correction: never invoke project Onboard from outside that project. A session does not change project identity just because its directory changes.

lessons.title: Survey, reuse and choose what Yoke takes over
lessons.when: First project onboarding or explicit adoption of existing work
lessons.need: An existing app needs mapping of docs, tests, CI and deployment. Agree on inherited work to adopt versus leave underway; a new project may need scaffolding.
lessons.gap: Define the adoption boundary for existing PRs/items, avoid duplicate seeding, and preserve accepted strategy. JOURNEYS proposes moving later infrastructure setup to the relevant moment.
